title: Music Production — High-η Signal Chain
intent: Raise the useful emotional and aesthetic joules produced per hour of studio time while remaining coherent with OpenRoot constraints.
eta_goal: More finished, resonant work with less wasted attention and plugin sprawl.
core_framing: Treat the signal chain as a thermodynamic path: every processor either increases ordered beauty or adds entropy.
Prioritize source quality and performance over corrective processing.
Emotional resonance and clarity are the measurable outputs; CPU and decision fatigue are the costs.
optimized_query_patterns: What is the minimum signal chain that still delivers the intended emotional payload?
Where is this mix leaking attention or adding unnecessary entropy?
constraints: Absolute path discipline for project files
verification_notes: Finished tracks per week and subjective resonance ratings versus hours invested.
next_physical_or_action: Finish one piece with a deliberately minimal chain and record the joule cost.
